solutions.title: Expanded string
solutions.strategy: Expand the compressed input into a full character array and iterate it.

timeComplexity.explanation: Construction expands all N output characters; each next is O(1).

solutions.title: Run parser
solutions.strategy: Parse one run at a time and decrement its remaining count lazily.

timeComplexity.explanation: Construction scans the compressed string once; next is amortized O(1).

spaceComplexity.explanation: Runs are stored as character/count pairs.
